description: Ask about process, revision, and rights - not about inspiration. The business side is where the unasked questions are, and artists are usually relieved to talk about it.

questions.text: What does the work look like on a bad day when you show up anyway?
questions.lands_because: Treats creative work as labor rather than as visitation, which is how working artists actually experience it and how interviewers rarely frame it.
followups: Is the work from those days distinguishable later?

questions.text: What did you cut from something you are proud of, and why?
questions.lands_because: Editorial judgment is the least discussed and most decisive part of making anything. It gets a specific answer where questions about intention get abstraction.
followups: Do you still have it? Do you look at it?

questions.text: Who owns what you made, and did you understand the deal when you signed it?
questions.lands_because: Rights and ownership determine an artist's entire economic life and almost never come up in interviews. Guests frequently have a hard-won story here.
followups: What do you tell people coming up about contracts?

questions.text: What pays for the work? Be specific about the mix.
questions.lands_because: Teaching, commissions, licensing, touring, day jobs, patronage - the real mix is far more interesting and useful than the myth of living off the art.
followups: Has the mix changed? Which part is disappearing?

questions.text: How do you tell the difference between criticism worth taking and criticism worth ignoring?
questions.lands_because: A real working problem with a real technique behind it, and it avoids both the fragile-artist and impervious-genius stereotypes.
followups: Whose note do you always take seriously?

questions.text: What has changed about reaching an audience, and what has that done to the work itself?
questions.lands_because: The second clause is the real question - platform incentives shaping form, length, and pacing is something artists feel keenly and discuss rarely.
followups: Have you made something differently because of it?
